xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4256: Effort on role launch surfaces: review parent, test, pan worker run, pan spawn, flywheel, dashboard agent actions, and remote Fly

plan.title: Effort on role launch surfaces: review parent, test, pan worker run, pan spawn, flywheel, dashboard agent actions, and remote Fly
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: S4 of the already eight-way-decomposed PAN-4249 effort program. Every code change is the same one mechanism (the caller calls resolveEffort and passes effort/effortSource, or forwards an explicit flag), each under ~15 lines, across 13 small items with 3 dependency edges. The file count is inflated by one test file per surface (the issue's AC requires a per-surface test) and the subsystem count by the lint treating each top-level doc file as its own subsystem. Splitting further would produce sibling issues of two or three files each.

narratives.Problem: roles.<role>.effort is validated for every role but most role launch surfaces ignore it: the review parent, the test role, pan worker run, pan spawn and remote Fly launch at role-file or hardcoded high (or with no effort at all), the Flywheel hardcodes high and never reads roles.flywheel.effort while its Settings copy claims the value applies next tick, and the dashboard agent start/restart routes cannot request a level.
narratives.Proposal: Apply PAN-4253's caller-resolves pattern to each surface: call resolveEffort (role, sub-role, issue, and model/harness when held) and pass effort + effortSource to spawnRun or the launcher; add an explicit --effort / body effort where the surface has an input (pan worker run, pan spawn, pan start --remote, POST /api/agents, POST /api/agents/:id/restart). spawnRun itself stays pass-through. Fix the RolesPanel copy and enum copy, and document every surface in configuration/effort.mdx and the CLI docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to src/lib/agents/spawn.ts (spawnRun/spawnAgent stay pass-through)
- No fix for pan spawn's missing harness binary (#4511)
- No tier/slot/swarm/foreman/tier-supervisor/merge-train effort (PAN-4257) and no planning-spawn effort (PAN-4258)
- No effort on RemoteAgentState, Agents rows, pan status/show, cost ledger or sessions.json (PAN-4259)
- No per-harness adapter fallback removal or mapping changes (PAN-4260)
- No --effort on pan flywheel start or POST /api/flywheel/start
- No effort override on restart-fresh, resume, recover, restart-all or restart-with-current-config; no change to switch-model (permanent 409)
- No dashboard UI effort picker for agent start or restart
- No change to review resume or review convoy lanes
- No change to sequencer-agent.ts, knowledge.ts, review-synthesis-recovery.ts or service-reactive.ts:326
- No xhigh or max default anywhere

autoDecisions.summary: Callers resolve effort; spawnRun stays pass-through
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4253 D5 explicitly assigned resolution to spawnRun callers in this slice and kept spawnRun a persist-and-thread primitive; spawn.ts also has only 15 lines of file-size headroom.

autoDecisions.summary: Review resume branch unchanged; only the fresh review spawn resolves
autoDecisions.rationale: Resume relaunches under the PAN-4253 pin rule, which already re-applies and re-clamps the persisted effort.

autoDecisions.summary: pan spawn resolves with item and plan metadata layers and role 'worker'
autoDecisions.rationale: The command already holds the xBRIEF doc and item, and its pane token role is 'worker'; tier effort is PAN-4257.

autoDecisions.summary: pan spawn passes effort as --effort for claude-code and -c model_reasoning_effort for codex, nothing for other harnesses
autoDecisions.rationale: These are the two harness CLIs pan spawn can address directly; the missing binary is a separate pre-existing defect filed as #4511.

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel pre-resolves roles.flywheel.effort and passes it as explicit to the conversation spawn; no CLI/API --effort
autoDecisions.rationale: spawnConversationSession resolves without a role, so it would ignore roles.flywheel.effort; the AC names config as the input.

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel resume keeps the effort it started with
autoDecisions.rationale: Resume relaunches from the stored conversations.effort (PAN-4254); the RolesPanel copy says so.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard start forwards only an explicit body effort
autoDecisions.rationale: Same principle as PAN-3857 for --model: forwarding a resolved default would be stamped as explicit; pan start already resolves roles.work.effort.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard restart accepts an explicit effort; other lifecycle routes do not; switch-model unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Restart is the operator relaunch action; the others relaunch under the pin rule or pan start's own resolution, and switch-model is a permanent 409 that launches nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: Restart body parsing extracted into shared.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: lifecycle-restart.ts has one line of file-size headroom and agents may not raise caps.
Persisting/displaying remote effort belongs to PAN-4259.
